name: vanishing-input
title: Vanishing Input
blurb: Input with rotating placeholders and canvas-based particle vanish animation.
description: A controlled or uncontrolled input with rotating placeholder suggestions that cycle every 3 seconds, and a canvas-based particle animation when submitted that dissolves the text.
use_when: Creating search or prompt interfaces where animated text effects and placeholder cycling enhance engagement.
avoid_when: On devices where canvas animations impact performance or when prefers-reduced-motion compliance is needed.
a11y: Input is semantic with keyboard support, but the particle animation does not respect prefers-reduced-motion.
